sentence: Tu Youyou has become the first female scientist of the People's Republic of China to receive a Nobel Prize, awarded for her contribution to the fight against malaria, one of the deadliest diseases in human history.
translation: 屠呦呦成为中华人民共和国第一位获得诺贝尔奖的女科学家，此奖表彰她在抗击疟疾——人类历史上最致命的疾病之一——方面作出的贡献。
analysis: 课件专项讲解句：the first... to receive——被序数词（the first/second/last/only）修饰的名词用不定式作后置定语，且与不定式构成逻辑主谓关系（课堂仿写：Jane Goodall was the first woman to study the connections between chimps and human beings.）| awarded for... 过去分词短语补充说明奖项（= which was awarded for...）| her contribution to the fight against malaria：三层介词链（对……战斗的贡献）| 句末 one of the deadliest diseases... 同位语再补一刀：点明疟疾的分量即点明贡献的分量 | 人物成就句的“头衔+缘由+分量”三段式——人物介绍类作文的黄金开篇
pattern: S + has become the first + N + to + V, awarded for ..., one of the + 最高级 + N
structures: 序数词+不定式后置定语
imitationCn: 她成为我校第一位在国际赛场上摘金的学生，获奖缘于她在机器人设计——最考验综合能力的项目之一——上的出色表现。
imitationHint: She has become the first student of our school to win gold on the international stage, awarded for her excellent performance in robot design, → one of the most demanding events（the first...to do + 同位语）
imitationAnswer: She has become the first student of our school to win gold on the international stage, awarded for her excellent performance in robot design, one of the most demanding events.

sentence: The efforts of Tu and her team finally paid off.
translation: 屠呦呦和她团队的努力终于得到了回报。
analysis: pay off 物作主语的核心考点：努力/坚持/冒险“奏效、得到回报”（All her effort paid off in the end.）——注意主语是 efforts 而非人；人作主语时 pay off 意为“还清（债务）”或“付清工资解雇”，一词两世界 | finally 副词卡在谓语前：漫长等待感（呼应上文多年失败实验）| 短句的叙事功能：长篇铺垫（190次实验失败）之后用最短的句子宣布成功——节奏落差即情感重量，与必修二 U1 的 All in all 短句收尾同理 | 读后续写“逆袭时刻”的必备句
pattern: The efforts of + sb + finally + paid off
imitationCn: 三个月的晨读坚持终于得到了回报。
imitationHint: Three months of morning reading → finally paid off（努力作主语）
imitationAnswer: Three months of morning reading finally paid off.

sentence: However, it was not until the 1970s that Tu succeeded in discovering qinghaosu, after many failed experiments.
translation: 然而，直到 20 世纪 70 年代，经历多次失败的实验之后，屠呦呦才成功发现了青蒿素。
analysis: 课件专项讲解句：not... until 与强调句的合体——It was not until + 时间 + that...“直到……才……”（课堂仿写：It was not until his partner pointed it out that he realized his mistake.）；注意 that 从句中谓语用肯定式（succeeded），否定已被 not until 吸收 | succeed in doing 成功做成（介词 in + 动名词）| after many failed experiments：failed 过去分词作定语“失败了的”——一个 failed 装下 190 次尝试 | the 1970s 年代表达（the + 数字s）| However 承上转折：前文各国攻关无果，此处中国科学家破局
pattern: It was not until + 时间 + that + S + succeeded in + V-ing, after + many failed + N
imitationCn: 直到第五次模拟考试，经历多次失利之后，他才终于突破了自己的瓶颈。
imitationHint: It was not until the fifth mock exam that he finally broke through his bottleneck, → after many failed attempts（强调句+not until）
imitationAnswer: It was not until the fifth mock exam that he finally broke through his bottleneck, after many failed attempts.

sentence: Without her broad knowledge of both traditional Chinese medicine and Western medicine, Tu might never have discovered qinghaosu.
translation: 如果没有她对中西医的广博了解，屠呦呦也许永远不会发现青蒿素。
analysis: 课件专项讲解句：without 引导的含蓄虚拟条件句——without sth = If she had not had...；主句 might never have discovered 用“情态动词 + have done”对过去虚拟（课堂对照：对现在虚拟用 might/could do——Without air and water, there could be no life on Earth.）| broad knowledge of both A and B：both...and 双领域并列正是发现的关键——虚拟句同时完成了“归因”论证 | 与必修二 U2 的 I would soon give up without a partner（对现在虚拟）构成时态姊妹篇 | 人物评价的高级句式：不直接夸，用“如果没有”反衬
pattern: Without + N, S + might never have + V-ed（对过去的含蓄虚拟）
imitationCn: 如果没有教练对每个细节的严格要求，我们也许永远不会站上领奖台。
imitationHint: Without the coach's strict attention to every detail, we might never have → stood on the podium（对过去虚拟：might never have done）
imitationAnswer: Without the coach's strict attention to every detail, we might never have stood on the podium.

sentence: Of course, if we make good things, it is not only to the credit of science; it is also to the credit of the moral choice which led us to good work.
translation: 当然，如果我们做出了好东西，这不仅归功于科学，也归功于引导我们行善的道德选择。
analysis: 费曼演讲（课件翻译题）| not only...; ...also 跨分号的递进并列：两个 it is to the credit of 平行结构，分号让“科学之功”与“道德之功”各占一席 | to the credit of sb/sth 归功于（课堂 credit 网络：to one's credit 值得称赞、credit A with B 把B归功于A、be credited as 被认为是）| the moral choice which led us to good work：which 定语从句——“道德选择”才是把科学导向善的方向盘 | if 从句 + 主句双 it：条件句里藏着演讲的核心论题（科学本身无善恶）——议论文让步-立论的经典话步
pattern: If + 从句, it is not only to the credit of + A; it is also to the credit of + B + which-从句
imitationCn: 如果我们赢得了比赛，这不仅归功于战术，也归功于让全队拧成一股绳的信任。
imitationHint: If we win the game, it is not only to the credit of tactics; → it is also to the credit of the trust which holds the whole team together（双 to the credit of 平行）
imitationAnswer: If we win the game, it is not only to the credit of tactics; it is also to the credit of the trust which holds the whole team together.

sentence: Never concerned that the answer may let us down, with pleasure and confidence we turn over each new stone to find unimagined strangeness leading on to more wonderful questions and mysteries.
translation: 我们从不担心答案会令人失望；怀着快乐与自信，我们翻开每一块新石头，发现意想不到的奇异，它们又引向更奇妙的问题与奥秘。
analysis: 课件双专项讲解句 | Never concerned that...：过去分词短语（否定式）作原因/伴随状语，逻辑主语是 we（= As we are never concerned...）；concerned 后接 that 从句说明担心内容 | with pleasure and confidence 介词短语前置——状语打头阵、主句殿后，句子重心层层推迟 | find unimagined strangeness leading on to...：find + 宾语 + 现在分词宾补（strangeness 与 lead 主动关系）——课堂 find 宾补全谱：done/doing/adj./adv./n./介短 | turn over each new stone 翻石头的科学探索隐喻 | let sb down 让某人失望 | 科学精神的诗意表达：把“未知”写成礼物而非威胁
pattern: Never + V-ed + that-从句, with + N we + V ... to find + O + V-ing ...
imitationCn: 从不担心尝试会失败，我们满怀好奇地推开每一扇新门，发现意想不到的风景通向更远的路。
imitationHint: Never worried that the attempt may fail, with curiosity we push open each new door → to find unexpected scenery leading on to longer roads（find + 宾 + doing）
imitationAnswer: Never worried that the attempt may fail, with curiosity we push open each new door to find unexpected scenery leading on to longer roads.

sentence: Now, we scientists take it for granted that it is perfectly possible to live and not know.
translation: 如今，我们科学家理所当然地认为：人活着而有所不知，是完全可能的。
analysis: 课件专项讲解句：双 it 各司其职——take it for granted that...中第一个 it 是形式宾语（真宾语为 that 从句）；从句内 it is perfectly possible to... 的 it 是形式主语（真主语为不定式）——一句话同框演示 it 的两大形式用法 | take... for granted 想当然、认为理所应当（Her parents were always there and she just took them for granted.）| to live and not know：not 直接否定第二个不定式（省 to），“活着”与“不知道”并置——费曼名言的哲学内核：科学的荣耀恰在承认无知 | we scientists 同位语（我们科学家）
pattern: S + take it for granted that + it is + adj. + to V and not + V
imitationCn: 如今，我们学习者理所当然地认为：一边进步一边犯错，是完全正常的。
imitationHint: Now, we learners take it for granted that → it is perfectly normal to progress and make mistakes（双 it 结构）
imitationAnswer: Now, we learners take it for granted that it is perfectly normal to progress and make mistakes.

sentence: Permit us to question — to doubt — to not be sure.
translation: 请允许我们发问——怀疑——不确定。
analysis: 三个不定式的破折号递进：to question → to doubt → to not be sure——从“提问”到“怀疑”再到“承认不确定”，怀疑的程度逐层加深；破折号制造演讲的停顿与心跳 | to not be sure：否定词插在 to 与动词之间的“分裂否定”——比标准 not to be 更口语更强调 not，费曼刻意为之的修辞破格 | permit sb to do 允许某人做（课堂拓展：permit doing、a work permit 许可证、Time permitting 时间允许的话——独立主格）| 祈使句向听众请命——演讲结尾向社会喊话的力度 | 七词短句配两破折号：极简与极重
pattern: Permit us to + V — to + V — to not + V（破折号递进）
imitationCn: 请允许我们尝试——犯错——再重新出发。
imitationHint: Permit us to try — to fail — → to start all over again（三不定式+破折号）
imitationAnswer: Permit us to try — to fail — to start all over again.

sentence: It is our responsibility as scientists, knowing the great progress that is the fruit of freedom of thought, to declare the value of this freedom; to teach how doubt is not to be feared but to be welcomed and discussed; and to demand this freedom as our duty to all coming generations.
translation: 作为科学家，我们深知巨大的进步是思想自由的果实，因此我们有责任：宣告这种自由的价值；教导人们疑惑不必畏惧、而应欢迎和讨论；并要求这种自由——这是我们对子孙后代应尽的义务。
analysis: 全书最长难句（课件翻译题）| 骨架：It is our responsibility... to declare...; to teach...; and to demand...——it 形式主语 + 三个并列不定式真主语，分号分隔（与必修二 U2 的三 that 从句、U1 的三表语排比构成“三排比”家族）| knowing... 现在分词插入作原因状语（逻辑主语 we），内嵌 that 定语从句（progress that is the fruit of...）| how doubt is not to be feared but to be welcomed：how 宾语从句 + be to be done 被动不定式 + not...but 对举 | as our duty to all coming generations 把责任推向时间深处 | 演讲收官句的教科书：结构即气势
pattern: It is our responsibility, V-ing ..., to V₁ ...; to V₂ ...; and to V₃ ...（三不定式分号排比）
imitationCn: 作为学长学姐，我们深知好习惯是时间的果实，因此我们有责任：分享自己的方法；告诉学弟学妹失败不必害怕、而应复盘和吸取；并把这种传承当作我们对下一届的义务。
imitationHint: It is our responsibility as senior students, knowing that good habits are the fruit of time, to share our methods; to teach how failure is not to be feared but to be reviewed and learned from; → and to pass on this tradition as our duty to the next class
imitationAnswer: It is our responsibility as senior students, knowing that good habits are the fruit of time, to share our methods; to teach how failure is not to be feared but to be reviewed and learned from; and to pass on this tradition as our duty to the next class.

sentence: He observed that the bacteria surrounding the mould were dead.
translation: 他观察到霉菌周围的细菌都死了。
analysis: observe that 宾语从句：“观察到……”（observe 课堂多义：观察/遵守 observe the law/庆祝 observe the festival/评论）| the bacteria surrounding the mould：surrounding 现在分词作后置定语（= that surrounded the mould）——主动关系用 -ing | bacteria 复数（单数 bacterium）→ 谓语 were，外来词复数的主谓一致陷阱 | mould 霉菌（熟词僻义：另义“模具”）| 青霉素发现的第一现场：一个 observed 开启了抗生素时代——科学叙事里“观察”永远是动词主角（呼应 Fortune favours the prepared mind）
pattern: S + observed that + the N + V-ing + N + were + adj.
imitationCn: 她注意到靠近窗台的那几株幼苗长得格外快。
imitationHint: She observed that the seedlings sitting near the windowsill → grew unusually fast（分词后置定语）
imitationAnswer: She observed that the seedlings sitting near the windowsill grew unusually fast.

sentence: One might think Fleming discovered penicillin by accident, but actually this is far from the truth.
translation: 有人可能认为弗莱明发现青霉素纯属偶然，但事实远非如此。
analysis: One might think...（有人可能会认为）：先摆常见误解——“立靶”话步；one 泛指、might 弱推测给足反驳空间 | by accident 偶然地（= by chance / accidentally；课堂拓展：It is no accident that... ……并非偶然）| but actually 转折+副词双保险 | far from the truth 远非事实（far from + n./adj./V-ing 表强否定：far from clear / far from destroying jobs——课堂专项；≈ anything but，呼应必修二 U3）| “误解→纠正”的科普框架：先承认直觉、再用事实反杀——下文正是弗莱明多年制备经验的铺陈
pattern: One might think + 从句, but actually this is far from the truth
imitationCn: 有人可能认为她的好成绩靠的是天赋，但事实远非如此。
imitationHint: One might think her good grades come from talent, → but actually this is far from the truth（下文接努力的证据）
imitationAnswer: One might think her good grades come from talent, but actually this is far from the truth.

translation: 幸运眷顾有准备的头脑。
analysis: 巴斯德名言（课文引用，评弗莱明的“偶然”发现）| 五词格言的浓缩术：Fortune 拟人化作主语（幸运会“偏爱”）；favour 动词“偏袒、眷顾”（课堂 favour 三义：偏袒/较喜欢/有利于——The warm climate favours tropical plants.）；the prepared mind 过去分词作定语 + mind 代人（提喻：以“头脑”代“人”）| 与上句 far from the truth 互为表里：没有 prepared，accident 只是 accident | 引用名言收束论证是议论文的点睛手法；此句可直接用于“机遇与准备”类作文——背诵级
pattern: Fortune favours the + V-ed + N（格言）
imitationHint: Opportunity favours → the ready hand / those who act（仿格言结构，简短有力）
